scope: Delegated review of SGLang decision-model documentation, pull requests and pinned implementation; no runtime benchmark performed
conclusion: The merged generic API scores ordinary chat-model vocabulary labels. Native trained decision checkpoints use a separate open PR. Neither demonstrates Kev pointer-head or CLM projection-head support.

prs.purpose: Generic typed decision API and System One adapter
Initial generic API; commits included in #41208
Native Intern-Decision checkpoints with positional marker readouts
Keep positional logprob readouts within a single prefill chunk; prerequisite for #41712

merged_path.validation_hardware: One H200, BF16; Qwen3.8 checked with and without NEXTN
pipeline: Serialize input; build one chat-template prompt per question
Disable thinking and validate single-token labels at the exact answer position
Pass all question sequences to score_prompts / score_request
Construct a batched GenerateReqInput with selected token logprobs and max_new_tokens=0
Read last-position vocabulary scores; softmax labels; map to typed answers
merged_path.readout: Existing vocabulary projection, without new decision heads
merged_path.batching: One scoring call can schedule several independent question sequences alongside generation; not one jointly answered marker prompt
merged_path.cache: Ordinary Radix token-prefix reuse. No independently encoded and cached action vectors.
merged_path.probability: softmax(label logits / temperature); label_mass measures probability assigned to all offered labels under the full vocabulary
merged_path.systemone_adapter: TypeSafe-compatible wire shape; confidence is a distribution statistic requiring task validation
merged_path.training: No new training recipe or head-training pipeline; uses served chat model
limitations: Request model field cannot select a LoRA adapter
Tokenizer/template and reasoning-block checks can reject a model
Decision-specific quantized accuracy/latency was not validated by this review

pipeline: Compile official trained prompt and JSON skeleton with one marker per answer field
Read answer-symbol vocabulary logits one position before each marker
Resolve readout positions after multimodal token expansion
Score all answer fields in one prefill; max_new_tokens=0
native_proposal.readout: Selected vocabulary symbols at multiple positions, rather than a Kev query/key pointer or CLM state/action projections
native_proposal.bounds: Up to 16 questions and 62 symbols per field; positional prompt must fit one prefill chunk
native_proposal.unsupported: Speculative decoding and template overrides are refused
native_proposal.images: Proposed native multimodal path; small parity checks reported, not production coverage
native_proposal.usage_convention: output_tokens equals number of answers despite no generated decoding tokens

cost_and_performance.benefit: Reuse a served chat model without training a new head, and reuse token prefixes through its existing scheduler
cost_and_performance.tradeoff: New joint prompts still incur tokenization and prefill. The documented H200 BF16 checks do not prove free-GPU fit.
cost_and_performance.cold_warm_reproducibility: Hybrid-attention probabilities shifted by up to approximately 0.07 across cache/batch states while checked choices stayed the same; compare matched cache conditions
cost_and_performance.generic_parity: Reported bitwise equality to /v1/score under matched cold-cache state

native_parity.setup: 400 Typed Decision rows, 2000 decisions, one H200 BF16
native_parity.meaning: Backend parity evidence, not a Kev-versus-CLM benchmark

cost_and_performance.latency: #41208 reports one approximately 9.5-second trial for 62 questions over a 31k-token state and explicitly disclaims a performance claim
cost_and_performance.comparison: No controlled comparison with Kev, CLM or llama.cpp was supplied
cost_and_performance.lab_recommendation: Optional serving comparison; does not replace frozen-encoder initial head training and Pac-Man fine-tuning

llama_cpp_distinction: Merged #29818 adds model-specific GGUF conversion and pointer/marker/vocabulary readouts for Julia, Laya, Kev, lev and OpenJev. Matching API shape does not imply matching architecture.
